questions.question: Prime cost consists of:
options: Direct materials plus direct labour — the costs that touch the product

questions.question: The factory foreman's salary is classified as:
options: A factory overhead — indirect, but still a production cost

questions.question: Advertising and the delivery bakkie's diesel belong to:
options: Selling and distribution — period costs that never enter production cost

questions.question: A cost that stays the same whether the month makes five thousand or nine thousand pairs is:
options: A fixed cost — like factory rent, within the normal range of output

subtopics.title: Three Stock Accounts Where the Trader Kept One

questions.question: The three states of a factory's product stock are:
options: Raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods

questions.question: Carriage of R14 000 on raw material purchases is:
options: Added to the cost of the raw materials, as carriage on purchases was for a trader

questions.question: Machine oil, needles and cleaning materials used in the factory flow into:
options: Factory overheads as indirect materials, via consumable stores

questions.question: Opening raw materials R84 000, purchases R516 000, carriage R14 000, closing stock R76 000. Raw materials issued to production:

subtopics.title: The Cost Accounts and the Flow to Finished Goods

questions.question: Direct labour cost of R402 000 is made up of:
options: Machinists' wages of R376 000 plus employer's contributions of R26 000
All salaries paid by the business

questions.question: Total manufacturing costs for the year are:
options: R1 340 000 — prime cost of R940 000 plus factory overheads of R400 000

questions.question: With opening work-in-progress R46 000 and closing R66 000, the cost of production of finished goods is:
options: R1 320 000 — transferred to finished goods stock

questions.question: 24 000 pairs were completed. The unit cost of production is:

subtopics.title: Ethics and Control on the Factory Floor

questions.question: Materials are issued from the storeroom only against:
options: Signed requisitions, with a storeman responsible for the locked store
A verbal request from any worker

questions.question: Comparing what a job SHOULD have used with what was issued detects:
options: Waste, damage or theft — each needing a different remedy

questions.question: Clock cards or biometric registers exist so that:
A factory that dumps waste into the river has:
options: Shifted its costs onto the community — and faces fines and closures that turn moral costs into financial ones

questions.question: At the vetkoek stand, flour, oil and mince are:
options: Direct materials — you can point at them inside the product

questions.question: The gas, the gazebo hire and the fryer wearing out form:
options: The overheads basket — costs of keeping the making possible

questions.question: The printed flyers advertising the stand are kept OUT of the making cost because:
options: They were too cheap to record
They are a cost of the day's selling, not of the vetkoek — and including them would distort the unit cost
Flyers are never a business cost

questions.question: As you fry more vetkoek, the gazebo hire per vetkoek:
options: Falls — a fixed cost spread over more units gets cheaper per unit

subtopics.title: Dough, Half-Fried, and Ready to Sell

questions.question: The three tables of the stand match the factory accounts as:
options: Sacks are raw materials, half-done is work-in-progress, the warmer is finished goods
Sacks are finished goods, the warmer is raw materials
The tables have no accounting meaning

questions.question: The table grammar — what was there, plus what arrived, minus what remains — gives:
options: What moved on — like the R538 000 of materials issued to production

questions.question: The cost that becomes part of the shoes is:
options: Only the R538 000 actually issued — the storeroom keeps back its closing stock

subtopics.title: One Pair of Shoes, Followed All the Way

questions.question: The rand's path through the factory runs:
options: Sacks to floor to store to customer — materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, cost of sales

questions.question: The unit cost of R55 per pair is called the factory's heartbeat because:
options: Watching it drift warns of leaks on the floor before any statement is drawn
It is measured monthly by law

questions.question: Finished goods: opening R90 000, production in R1 320 000, closing R110 000. Cost of sales is:
Sales of R1 950 000 against cost of sales of R1 300 000 confirm:
options: A gross profit of R650 000 — exactly 50 percent on cost
